lastCompletedStory.title: Planner-produced-no-prd is a failure: escalate to idle, never spawn the auditor

nextStoryContext: US-003 added 'planner-failed' to PlanPhaseResult union in plan-runner.ts. Two new helpers: isPlannerNoPrd (guard after pollPlannerDeath: pane died without prd.json -> return planner-failed, auditor NEVER spawned) and resolveLivePaneId (extracted ternary for ensureWorkerPane fallback, reduces runPlanPhase complexity + lines). runPostAuditAction handles 'planner-failed': calls notifyFn best-effort, skips escalateFn, returns no-action (phase exits to idle via exitPhaseAfterPlan). Two test files prove AC1 (15 unit tests) and AC2/AC3 (1 behavioral oracle with real tmux, private socket cam-it-noprd). All quality gates pass (2621 tests, typecheck clean, check:all exit 0).

officialDocsValidated.summary: All changes are in internal cam-cli modules (plan-runner.ts helpers, test files). No external npm library was added or changed.
